    (2024, True),
    
    # Non-leap years (not divisible by 4)
    (3, False),
    (5, False),
    (2001, False),
    (2002, False),
    (2003, False),
    
    # Century years not divisible by 400
    (1800, False),
    (1900, False),
    (2000, True),
    (2100, False),
    (2200, False),

]
